title: No longer ceramic, but plastic.
text: No longer ceramic, but plastic.. Two years ago these used to be made out of ceramic, and now they are cheesy plastic. I returned and found better ones at BB&B.

product_metadata.title: iDesign 99000 Duetto Plastic Toilet Bowl Brush and Holder, Slim Set for Bathroom Cleaning and Storage, 4" x 4" x 17.2", White and Chrome
features: TOILET BOWL BRUSH AND HOLDER: Plastic bowl brush and holder is perfect for bathroom cleaning and maintenance. Holder discreetly conceals brush when not in use. Ideal for kids' bathroom, guest bathroom, master bathroom, office bathroom, and more!
STYLISH: White finish with chrome accents is a classic design that matches any decor
DURABLE: Made with durable plastic for years of quality use
REPLACEABLE HEAD: Brush head is removable for replacement when it comes time to freshen up
COMPACT SIZE: Toilet bowl brush and holder measure 4" x 4" x 17.2", perfect for your bathroom
description: The iDesign Duetto Toilet Brush and Holder is the perfect addition to your bathroom. Made of plastic, this bowl brush features a stiff bristle brush head that's removable for easy replacement. The tasteful holder is made of durable plastic with chrome accents and discreetly hides the brush when not in use. The wide base keeps it sturdy and prevents it from tipping over easily. The holder is compact and fits neatly into the small spaces or corners of your bathroom to optimize space. The iDesign Duetto Toilet Brush and Holder measures 4" x 4" x 17.2", perfect for your bathroom! With iDesign by InterDesign, you can #LiveSimply every day.
